benefits.title: Consultation Requests Answered at Any Hour
benefits.body: People look for a lawyer or tax consultant the moment a problem starts keeping them up, often at night or on a weekend. Cekat.AI's agent replies the moment the chat arrives, explaining services, the documents to prepare, and the next step, so a serious inquiry never evaporates because the office opens Monday.

benefits.title: Repetitive Intake Questions Handled by AI
benefits.body: "Do you handle cases like mine?" "Which documents do I need?" "How long does the process take?" The same intake questions arrive every day. Cekat.AI answers them in natural language from your firm's knowledge base, then asks about the need, urgency, and basic details, so what reaches a partner is a well-formed inquiry, not an empty chat.

faq.q: How does Cekat.AI help law firms and professional practices?
faq.a: It answers consultation requests instantly 24/7 on WhatsApp and web chat, handles the intake questions that repeat every day, schedules consultations, and organizes every inquiry into a pipeline per partner or service line. Your team spends its hours on the actual work, not on answering the same chats.

faq.q: Can the AI qualify prospective clients before a consultation?
faq.a: Yes. The AI asks what your intake staff would ask, the type of need, its urgency, and the basic details of the matter or project, then records it all on a lead card. Partners walk into consultations with a clear picture, and inquiries outside your services are politely redirected early.

faq.q: Does the AI give legal or tax advice?
faq.a: No. The AI handles intake, answering general questions about services, process, and documents from a knowledge base your firm approves, and routes anything substantive to a consultation with the professional. You define those boundaries through the AI's instructions.

faq.q: Can consultation bookings connect to our office calendar?
faq.a: Yes. Through API integration, schedules the AI captures in chat can flow into the calendar or booking system your office already uses, and automated reminders go out before each appointment to reduce no-shows. Rescheduling is handled in the same conversation.

faq.q: How is prospective client confidentiality protected?
faq.a: Cekat.AI complies with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) in handling and managing user data, and ISO 27001 certification is in progress. Access within the office is role-based, so conversations and prospect data are visible only to the people who should see them.

faq.q: When does a conversation move to a partner or staff member?
faq.a: Whenever your rules say so, for instance when a prospect starts discussing the substance of a matter, the case is sensitive, or they ask for a person. The conversation hands over to the right person with the chat history and intake results attached, so the client never repeats their story.

WhatsApp (official Business API), Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, and live chat on your office website, all flowing into one inbox with a single history per contact. A prospect who starts on your website chat and continues on WhatsApp still reads as one person.

faq.q: How long does setup take for a professional office?
faq.a: Building the AI agent takes around five minutes, paste your list of services, processes, required documents, and intake SOPs into the knowledge base and it starts answering accurately. No coding is required; Cekat.AI describes it as being as easy as briefing a new receptionist.

faq.q: Is there a trial, and how does pricing work?
faq.a: There is a 14-day free trial to test it on your own number. Pricing comes as plans that scale with team size and conversation volume, from a solo practice to a firm with many partners, book a free consultation and our team will help you pick the right fit.
